data.name: Grauwall
data.detailed_description:
The Bell of Grauwall has broken.
For generations its toll kept the dead asleep beneath the fortress. Now the bone legion wakes — and you are the last Bellwarden.

Descend.
Ten floors lie between you and the deep. Each one is built anew: winding corridors, torchlit chambers, hidden chests. No two descents are the same.

Choose your hero.
• Knight — balanced health, speed and damage
• Barbarian — a bulwark with heavy blows
• Ranger — fast and agile, but fragile
• Mage — fights at range with arcane bolts

Die. Learn. Descend again.
Death drags you back to the surface — but your gold remains. Spend it to unlock new heroes and brave the dark once more.

They wait below.
On the fifth floor the Skeleton King rises. Deeper still, in the final hall, the Bone Sorcerer awaits.

Features
• Procedurally generated dungeons — every run is new
• Four heroes, each with a distinct feel
• Direct melee combat with dodge rolls
• Gold, chests and healing potions
• Progress that outlasts death
• 13 languages — English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Serbian, Turkish, Arabic, Chinese, Japanese

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard and mouse required
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
